skill.displayName: CTR Fix: Title and Meta Description Rewrites - SEOmatic

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent SEO workflow that uses a disclosed SEOmatic MCP integration to analyze Search Console data and stage CTR fixes with user approval.

dimensions.detail: Access to Search Console, site page data, SERP checks, and SEOmatic task staging is proportionate for CTR optimization and is described in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requires connecting the remote SEOmatic MCP server with OAuth or a Bearer API key; this is disclosed and consistent with the integration purpose.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to page-1 CTR underperformance, require real GSC data, avoid guesses, and explicitly prohibit approving tasks without the user's specific consent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No bundled executable code, local persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, or system modification behavior is present; paid task staging is disclosed and approval-gated.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested capabilities match the stated purpose: Search Console CTR analysis, SERP feature checks, page snippet reads, and staging title/meta-description tasks for approval.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable connecting SEOmatic to Search Console and allowing the agent to stage SEO task cards. The artifact says changes should not be approved or executed unless you explicitly approve the specific task.
